rule: Each eligible player may move once during a round, at any time before voting begins.
room_a_b: Players who can occupy Room A or Room B may move between these rooms.
command_room_access: Only the current Captain may enter Command Room.
captain_after_leaving: Leaving Command Room does not remove Captain status. The Captain may return using a later available movement.
one_move_implication: After leaving Command Room, a return cannot occur in the same round under the one-move-per-round limit.
hospital_and_jail: No voluntary movement from Hospital or Jail.
command_room_immunity: The room's protection applies while a player is inside Command Room.
note: This decision updates the movement and Captain location wording in the v2.1 playtest draft; other rules remain as written.
